situations.title: 지속 심전도 모니터·리드 관리
situations.tagline: These sticky patches keep coming loose — is the monitor even reading me right?
situations.brief: 리드 위치를 정확히 하고 아티팩트를 줄여 지속 심전도 모니터를 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll reposition the leads so we get a clean tracing.
Some of that squiggle is just movement, not your heart.
Good contact helps the monitor read you accurately.

situations.title: 새 부정맥 인지·기록
situations.tagline: His rhythm just changed on the monitor — can you print a strip?
situations.brief: 새로 나타난 부정맥을 인지하고 리듬 스트립을 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: His rhythm has changed — I'll print a strip now.
Let me compare it to his baseline tracing.
I'll document it and notify the physician.

situations.title: 항부정맥제 주입 준비
situations.tagline: Let's get an amiodarone load ready for him.
situations.brief: 아미오다론 등 항부정맥제의 로딩을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll prepare the amiodarone loading dose per protocol.
I'll confirm the concentration and infusion rate.
I'm watching his rhythm and pressure during the load.

situations.title: 심박수·혈압 동반 사정
situations.tagline: My heart's racing and I feel a bit lightheaded — is my blood pressure okay?
situations.brief: 심박수와 혈압을 함께 사정해 부정맥의 혈역학 영향을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm checking your heart rate and blood pressure together.
A fast rhythm can sometimes lower your pressure.
Tell me if you feel more dizzy or short of breath.

situations.title: K·Mg 전해질 채혈
situations.tagline: Let's draw a potassium and magnesium — these arrhythmias may be electrolyte-driven.
situations.brief: 부정맥 유발인자를 확인하기 위해 칼륨과 마그네슘을 채혈하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll draw a potassium and magnesium level now.
Low electrolytes can trigger these rhythms.
I'll report the results and anticipate replacement.

situations.title: 텔레메트리 경보 응답
situations.tagline: That monitor's been alarming — can you check if it's real or just artifact?
situations.brief: 텔레메트리 경보의 우선순위를 판단해 신속히 응답하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll go check the patient before silencing the alarm.
This one's real, not artifact — I'm assessing him now.
I'll prioritize the alarms that signal danger.

situations.title: 새 심방세동 RVR 관리
situations.tagline: She just flipped into a-fib with RVR in the 150s — how do you want to control the rate?
situations.brief: 심박수를 조절하고 혈역학을 감시하며 새 심방세동 RVR을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: She's in a-fib with a rate in the 150s.
We'll start rate control and watch her pressure.
I'll monitor for any signs she's becoming unstable.

situations.title: 안정 SVT 미주신경·아데노신
situations.tagline: My heart's pounding really fast — is there something you can do to slow it down?
situations.brief: 미주신경 자극과 아데노신 처치를 보조하고 환자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: First, try bearing down like you're having a bowel movement.
If that doesn't work, we'll give a quick medication called adenosine.
It may feel strange for a few seconds, but it works fast.

situations.title: 서맥·전도차단 관리
situations.tagline: He's dropping into the 40s with a heart block — should we get atropine and the pacer pads ready?
situations.brief: 아트로핀을 준비하고 경피 페이싱을 대비해 서맥과 전도차단을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: He's bradycardic with a heart block into the 40s.
I'll draw up atropine and place the pacer pads.
If atropine fails, we start transcutaneous pacing.

situations.title: QT 연장 약물 감시
situations.tagline: His QT is stretching out on these meds — are we at risk for torsades?
situations.brief: QT 연장을 감시하고 TdP 위험을 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: His QT interval is prolonging on the monitor.
This raises his risk for torsades de pointes.
Let's review his medications and check his electrolytes.

situations.title: 전해질 교정으로 부정맥 안정화
situations.tagline: His potassium and mag came back low — let's replace them to settle the rhythm.
situations.brief: 칼륨과 마그네슘을 보정 프로토콜에 따라 교정해 부정맥을 안정화하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll replace his potassium and magnesium per protocol.
Correcting these often calms the arrhythmia.
I'll recheck the levels after replacement.
goals: 교정 후 부정맥 안정 여부를 평가한다

situations.title: 경정맥 임시 페이싱 관리
situations.tagline: Can you check the temporary pacer — is it capturing at this threshold?
situations.brief: 경정맥 임시 페이싱의 캡처와 역치를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll check that each pacer spike is capturing.
Let me set the output a bit above the capture threshold.
I'll secure the wires and watch for any loss of capture.

situations.title: 예정 심율동전환 준비
situations.tagline: So you're going to shock my heart back to normal — what do I need to do to get ready?
situations.brief: 항응고와 진정, 동의를 확인해 예정된 심율동전환을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll confirm your blood thinner has been at the right level.
You'll get sedation, so you won't feel the shock.
I'll go over the consent and answer any questions.

situations.title: 페이스메이커·ICD 환자 모니터
situations.tagline: I've got a defibrillator in my chest — will it go off while I'm in here?
situations.brief: 장치 상호작용을 감시하며 페이스메이커·ICD 환자를 모니터하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm watching how your device is working with your rhythm.
If it fires, it's doing its job to protect you.
Tell me right away if you feel a shock or a jolt.

situations.title: 부정맥 유발 허혈 감별
situations.tagline: Is this new rhythm from ischemia, or is it just his electrolytes?
situations.brief: 심전도와 심근효소를 통합해 부정맥 유발 허혈을 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's get a 12-lead and cardiac enzymes.
We need to rule out ischemia as the trigger.
I'll compare this tracing to his baseline.

situations.title: 불안정 빈맥 응급 심율동전환
situations.tagline: She's unstable with this fast rhythm — set up for a synchronized cardioversion!
situations.brief: 불안정 빈맥에 대해 동기화 심율동전환을 신속히 준비하고 수행하세요.
keyPhrases: She's unstable — we need synchronized cardioversion.
Make sure the sync is on before we shock.
I'll give sedation if she's awake enough.

situations.title: 무맥성 VT·VF 제세동
situations.tagline: He's in v-fib and pulseless — start CPR and charge to defibrillate!
situations.brief: 무맥성 VT·VF에서 즉각 CPR과 제세동을 수행하세요.
keyPhrases: He's in v-fib and pulseless — start compressions now.
Charge to 200 and clear.
Resume CPR immediately after the shock.

situations.title: 완전방실차단 심정지 임박
situations.tagline: He's in complete heart block and barely perfusing — get the transcutaneous pacer on now!
situations.brief: 완전방실차단 상황에서 경피 페이싱을 시작하고 에스컬레이션하세요.
keyPhrases: He's in complete heart block with a dangerously slow rate.
Place the pacer pads and start transcutaneous pacing.
I'm calling for transvenous pacing backup.

situations.title: TdP 급변 마그네슘 응급
situations.tagline: She just broke into torsades — push magnesium, stat!
situations.brief: TdP 급변 시 마그네슘을 즉시 투여하고 소생을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: She's in torsades — give IV magnesium now.
Get the defibrillator ready in case she deteriorates.
Stop any QT-prolonging drugs immediately.

situations.title: 전기폭풍 반복 제세동 관리
situations.tagline: That's his fourth shock in an hour — we need a plan for this electrical storm.
situations.brief: 반복되는 제세동이 필요한 전기폭풍을 진정과 항부정맥제로 관리하고 팀과 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: He's had repeated shocks — this is an electrical storm.
We need deeper sedation and antiarrhythmics on board.
Let's get cardiology and coordinate the next steps.

situations.title: 페이싱 캡처 실패 위기
situations.tagline: The pacer's firing but it's not capturing and his rate's crashing — help me troubleshoot!
situations.brief: 페이싱 캡처 실패 위기에 문제를 해결하고 백업 페이싱을 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: The pacer spikes aren't capturing — his rate is dropping.
I'll increase the output and check the connections.
Get backup pacing ready in case this fails.
